title: Milestone bundles and release-notes runway for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Asha Patel
description: Define and operationalize a lightweight "milestone bundle" approach to group smaller feature deliveries across API, Console, and Runtime into coherent release packages. Create a 'release-notes runway' process to stitch product copy, engineering callouts, and rollout guidance together so cross-functional stakeholders can sign off on release scope, rollouts, and comms in a repeatable way.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone bundle definitions created for 3 bundles (Core API, Console UX, Runtime perf) with clear scope lists
Cut criteria defined and measurable for each bundle (latency, error budget, regression thresholds, docs readiness)
Canonical release-notes doc created and linked; PMs/Eng/Design have signoff workflow established
Cross-team rollout matrix (regions, dedicated/private customers, canary windows) published and validated with SRE and Sales
Launch checklist automated in runbook and assigned owners for each preflight signal
tasks: Workshop: alignment session with Eng/Console/Runtime leads to define bundle boundaries (owner: Marco Li)
Draft cut criteria per bundle and circulate for engineering measurement feasibility (owner: Priya Raman)
Create canonical release-notes template and examples; coordinate with Docs (owner: Eva Morales)
Build rollout matrix spreadsheet; include region, capacity tier, canary window, rollback signal thresholds (owner: SRE lead)
Schedule two dry-run rehearsals for release-notes assembly and signoff flow (owner: Release Ops)
Automate preflight signal checks in CI/CD to gate final cut (owner: ENG-DevOps)
Communications: prepare GTM summary and sales-facing FAQ drafts (owner: Growth PM)
Finalize embargo windows and publish release calendar entry (owner: PM Communications)
Postmortem template prepared for bundle releases to capture regressions and notes (owner: Ops)
Tagging/metadata for telemetry dashboards to reflect bundle rollouts (owner: Telemetry team)
decisions: Adopt 'milestone bundles' to reduce per-release coordination overhead; bundles will be timeboxed to 3-week windows
Cut criteria will be quantitative where possible (p95 latency delta <= 5%, error budget impact < 5%) and qualitative for UX issues
Release-notes runway will be the single source of truth for GTM and will include a TL;DR, technical notes, known issues, rollback plan, and customer impact summary
All bundles will have a required Docs entry and at least one canary region before global rollout
rollout_plan: T-28 days: Bundle scope freeze and start release-notes draft
T-14 days: Engineering signoff on cut criteria and preflight automation enabled
T-7 days: Docs and Console copy finalized, canary windows scheduled
T-2 days: Dry-run of signoff flow and final checklist validation
Day 0: Canary launch (10% traffic) + telemetry smoke checks; if green, proceed to staged ramp
Day 0+1 to +3: Ramp to 50% with continuous monitoring; if anomalies, execute rollback plan
Day 7: Post-release review and notes consolidation
risks: Underestimated integration work between Console copy and API behavior leading to inaccurate notes
Telemetry tags not in place, preventing quick detection of regressions for bundled features
SRE capacity conflicts if multiple bundles require overlapping canary windows
Sales/Customer Success surprised by subtle behavioral changes without clear comms
mitigations: Require Docs stub before scope freeze; engineering to provide example API responses for copy team
Enforce telemetry tagging as a hard dependency in the release checklist
Coordinate canary windows across bundles and reserve SRE capacity; limit concurrent canaries to 2
Pre-brief Sales Enablement with FAQ and feature impact matrix at T-14
